name: mirage
text: Researched Novig's help center. Yes, it keeps your records, but there is no automatic full report. 1) Tax form: Novig sends a 1099-MISC in the first two weeks of February (email and mail) only if your total redemptions for the year were $2000+ AND net redemptions (redemptions minus purchases) were above $0. With a ~$4 net loss you may get none, which does NOT mean nothing is reportable. Its own help says the 1099 shows net redemptions, not your trading profit, so it can differ from what you owe. 2) Records: in the app, Account icon > Transactions tab shows your full history. For a formal statement, message Live Chat with the date range (e.g. Jan 1 - Dec 31, 2026); they say 1-2 business days. 3) Before Aug 4, 2026 (the old sweepstakes model): Settings gear > Account Preferences > Request Historical Data, they email it to you. Do that now, it covers your older bets. 4) Caveat: those help pages are written for the sweepstakes model; I found nothing on how the new exchange setup (after Aug 4) is reported for taxes, so ask Live Chat that exact question and keep the statements they send. Sources: https://support.novig.com/en/articles/13835887-tax-reporting-on-novig-1099s-trading-history-more and https://support.novig.com/en/articles/16237795-how-to-request-your-historical-account-data . I can also total your winnings/losses from the Tracker's saved bets as a cross-check.
